newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Faulding says wins FDA drug approval.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Faulding says wins FDA drug approval.

text.p: F.H. Faulding and Co Ltd said it had received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market a generic anticonvulsant drug.
Faulding said its Purepac Pharmaceutical Co unit had received approval to market clonazepam tablets, with the market valued at a total of US$264 million annually.
Clonazepam is an anticonvulsant used alone or as an adjunct in the treatment of the Lennox-Gastaut Syndrome akinetic and myocionic seizures, Faulding said.
Product shipments to customers were expected to begin in the calendar 1997 first quarter.
The product said this was the fourth Faulding drug to receive FDA approval in calendar 1996.
